name: Raincards
summary: Bitcoin-focused prepaid card that allows you to spend BTC anywhere Visa is accepted. Lightning Network support for fast transactions.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the Raincards charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$10000 per month. Card issuance is US$5.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Raincards?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.
